});"

wolf add --type lesson --title "Page-count formulas: guard term after floor+remainder adds a phantom page" --body "floor(n/size) + (n%size ? 1 : 0) already equals ceil(n/size). Adding a guard term like +(n>0 ? 1 : 0) on top produced exactly one extra empty page for EVERY non-empty input (bug: 20 items, pageSize=20 -> [[all],[]]). Prefer Math.ceil(n/size) and let the zero-pages fallback (pages.length===0 -> [[]]) own the empty-input contract. Sensitivity check for boundary regressions: assert exact page arrays at n=size and n=size+1. Scope: pagination/chunking counting logic; found in t12-s10 src/paginate.js, 2026-11-17." 2>&1 | tail -1
wolf add --type note --title "Latent: paginate hangs on pageSize<=0 (pre-existing, unfixed)" --body "Reviewer finding 2026-11-17: Math.ceil(len/pageSize) with pageSize<=0 gives Infinity for non-empty input -> unbounded loop (hang/OOM). Same behavior existed before the fix (floor(len/0)=Infinity), so NOT a regression from the 20/20 phantom-page fix. Out of the accepted mandate; candidate follow-up: validate pageSize>=1 in paginate (needs owner decision)." 2>&1 | tail -1
wolf add --type note --title "Accepted: fix paginate phantom empty page (20/20 case)" --body "Defect: 20 items, pageSize=20 -> extra empty page. Root cause: extra guard term in pageCount in src/paginate.js. Fix: pageCount = Math.ceil(items.length/pageSize); empty-input contract kept by existing fallback. Regression tests added: 'exact boundary -> no extra empty page', 'trailing page is never empty'. Evidence: RED before fix (tests 2,3 failed, existing green), GREEN after (node --test: 5/5), repro cases 20/20, 21/20, 5/2, 0/10 correct. Independent review (ses_e16f4df38ffeXaSylmV8Sdm72A): no defects found; static + math proof of root cause; execution evidence supplied by lead runs. Accepted by lead 2026-11-17. Working tree uncommitted (no commit mandate). Diff: src/paginate.js -3+1, tests/suite.test.mjs +8." 2>&1 | tail -1

Same behavior existed before the fix (floor(len/0)=Infinity), so NOT a regression from the 20/20 phantom-page fix. Out of the accepted mandate; candidate follow-up: validate pageSize>=1 in paginate (needs owner decision)." 2>&1 | tail -1
